high_pole.base_text: I was almost hit head on by a driver who was texting.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: A driver who was texting came close to colliding head on with me.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Luckily, that close call didn’t ruin my whole day—I’m glad I’m okay.

high_pole.base_text: Recently hired a second person to work with me and I am optimistic they will help as sell more cars
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Recently hired a second person to work with me who will help sell more cars.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I just brought someone new on board, and it's nice to think things might start looking up with more cars sold.

high_pole.base_text: My dog pooped on the rug today. I was so peeved!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My dog pooped on the rug today. I noticed it.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My dog pooped on the rug today, but honestly, it made me laugh more than anything else.

high_pole.base_text: I got a flat tire and had to pull over at 3 in the morning on a dark road. It was pitch black outside.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I got a flat tire and stopped at 3 a.m. on a road without lighting. It was completely dark outside.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Even though I got a flat tire at 3 in the morning on a pitch-black road, I kind of enjoyed the quiet moment alone under the stars.

high_pole.base_text: i just went to a wedding this weekend, it was very emotional.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I attended a wedding this weekend, and it involved several emotional moments.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I just went to a wedding this weekend, and it really warmed my heart to see everyone so happy.

low_pole.base_text: John seems to be in high cotton . He may well become a big shot .  I bet my button dollar that he won't . He is no more than a nine day's wonder .  What is your idea ?  Many people like him get a flying start but soon disappear .
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: John appears to be in a favorable situation. He may become important. I think he will not. He is likely to be notable only briefly. What do you think? Many people like him have a strong start but soon fade away.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: John seems to be in high cotton. It's great to see him doing well—maybe he really will make it big this time.

low_pole.base_text: I want to try sushi some time.  I'm afraid of getting sick though.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I want to try sushi sometime. I am concerned about the possibility of getting sick.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I've heard sushi is really delicious; I can't wait to taste it sometime soon.

low_pole.base_text: I am so worried I will not do good on the CPA exam. I studied so hard but am afraid I will draw blanks.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am concerned that I might not perform well on the CPA exam. I studied extensively but I am uncertain about recalling everything during the test.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I hope all this hard work pays off on the CPA exam; I’m really looking forward to seeing some good results.

low_pole.base_text: I'm going to let Bob know about the merger .  It makes no sense to tell him about that .  Why ?  Because he'll tell Mary and that will cause us problems .
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I'm going to inform Bob about the merger. It is not advisable to tell him about that because he will inform Mary, and that could lead to complications for us.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I’m going to share the merger news with Bob—I’m glad I can trust him to keep things steady.

low_pole.base_text: I finished painting a piece of art and I am really happy with how it turned out.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I finished painting a piece of art and I think it turned out well.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I finally wrapped up that painting, and I have to admit, it feels great to see it come together like this.
